title: ReservationActionsContract
description: The reservation actions beside POST /api/v1/event-missions/:id/register, whose answer is reservation-response.schema.json: withdrawal, a leader's slot assignment and clearance, and squad holds. The root is the registration body.

RegistrationRequest.description: POST /api/v1/event-missions/:emid/register body: the wanted slot id, or an empty string to register without a seat.

RegistrationWithdrawal.description: DELETE /api/v1/event-missions/:emid/register answer: the caller's reservation is withdrawn and its seat released.

SlotAssignmentRequest.description: PUT /api/v1/event-missions/:emid/slots/:slotId/assign body (leader): the member to seat.

SlotAssignmentOutcome.description: PUT /api/v1/event-missions/:emid/slots/:slotId/assign answer: the member now holding the slot.

SlotClearance.description: DELETE /api/v1/event-missions/:emid/slots/:slotId/assign answer: the slot is empty.

SquadRequest.description: POST /api/v1/event-missions/:emid/squads/reserve and .../release body (leader): the squad name.

SquadReservation.description: POST /api/v1/event-missions/:emid/squads/reserve answer: the squad hold, 201 when created, 200 when it already existed.

SquadRelease.description: POST /api/v1/event-missions/:emid/squads/release answer: the squad hold is gone.
